results.name: Captured W820NB packets decode and re-encode exactly
V2 plain and XOR packets match independent fixed vectors
V1 and V2 reject corruption, wrong lengths and unsupported encryption
Stream decoding accepts fragmented and combined notifications
Decoder recovers after invalid checksum and bounds input
V2 length uses both bytes
Exact model identity rejects related and unknown products
Battery parser preserves unknown and single-ear states
Unknown capability groups expose no writable options
W820NB settings are backed up before writes and verified
Lolli v2 ANC and touch settings use the TWS profile
V2 ANC group comes from the status response
Unknown wear detection group cannot be written
Every value is validated before the first write
Backup failure prevents all device writes
Readback mismatch stops a batch and requires reconnect
Restore rejects device, firmware, capability, protocol and preview mismatches
Missing readback disables a setting before mutation
Cancelled operations do not write
W830NB identifies both official service families without accepting related products
Multipoint decodes legacy and indexed status and preserves the index
W830NB reads headset battery and independently reported ANC modes
Lolli multipoint uses indexed payload and restores from its automatic backup
Single-ear and unsupported multipoint operations cannot write
Unrecognized multipoint responses do not expose a writable setting
Multipoint restart happens last and remains unconfirmed until a fresh connection
An acknowledgement without a readable multipoint state is not success
Multipoint mismatch and backup format mismatch stop further writes
A failed backup or invalid multipoint value prevents the write
Lolli 1.0.9 ANC transitions tolerate stale reads and omit inactive ambient gain
Lolli ambient backup restores from a mode that does not report gain
Stored gain is verified in ambient mode before returning to ANC
Persistent ANC mismatch is explicit and never retries a write
Incorrect ambient gain blocks the final ANC write
Unreadable ANC after a write cannot be accepted as success
ANC no-op creates no write or uncertainty
Observed Lolli capabilities expose EQ50 and all six touch slots without inventing sensitivity
Nested touch cycles use the selected action and preserve both the parent and mask on restore
Invalid or incomplete touch cycles reject the whole batch before any write
A missing nested touch mask cannot be overwritten as a simple action
Touch and sensitivity writes require both earbuds online
New prompt protocol carries its reported group and setting position
Malformed and unknown prompt responses provide no editable prompt values
Sensitivity validates the reported range and preserves the index
Name changes validate UTF8 bytes and read the new name back
A name acknowledgement without the target readback remains uncertain
Renamed device identities persist by address digest and invalid records are ignored
Shutdown timer handles high-byte durations and cancellation without putting it into batch settings
A decrementing timer is accepted but a disabled timer is not accepted as an active timer
Device actions are capability gated, backed up, sent once, and require reconnection
A device action with a lost acknowledgement is not reported as completed
LDAC is a separate operation and does not silently restore from a general settings backup
Custom EQ parses independent fixed packets and rejects malformed bands
Custom EQ edits validate all bands before writing and confirm each changed band
Custom EQ mismatch stops after the first band without retries or false success
Four-byte and banked custom EQ packets preserve frequencies and bank identity
Variable-count EQ honors the returned count and rejects duplicate or excessive band indexes
Custom EQ reset is read back and gain units follow the device group
Every new operation fails closed when the backup cannot be written
Finder audio has bounded duration and amplitude with the unselected channel silent
